get.description: Retrieve feature flags for a project. Returns an opaque cursor for pagination.

parameters.name: projectIdOrName
parameters.description: The project id or name

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: The state of the flags to retrieve. Defaults to `active`.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of flags to return.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Pagination cursor to continue from.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Search flags by their slug or description. Case-insensitive.

parameters.name: tags
parameters.description: Filter flags by tag. Repeat the parameter for multiple tags (all must match).

parameters.name: createdBy
parameters.description: Filter flags by the id of the entity that created them (a user or team id).

parameters.name: maintainerIds
parameters.description: Filter flags by maintainer user id. Repeat the parameter for multiple maintainers (any may match).

parameters.name: includeMarketplaceFlags
parameters.description: Whether to include Marketplace experimentation items in the paginated response. Defaults to false.

parameters.name: teamId
parameters.description: The Team identifier to perform the request on behalf of.

parameters.name: slug
parameters.description: The Team slug to perform the request on behalf of.

400.description: One of the provided values in the request query is invalid.

402.description: The account is missing a payment so payment method must be updated

403.description: You do not have permission to access this resource.

get.description: Retrieve feature flags for a project. The list can be filtered by state and supports pagination.

parameters.name: projectIdOrName
parameters.description: The project id or name

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: The state of the flags to retrieve. Defaults to `active`.

parameters.name: withMetadata
parameters.description: Deprecated. Whether to include creator metadata in each flag in the response. Resolve creator identity client-side (e.g. via the team members endpoint) instead; this parameter will be removed in a future release. Use `GET /v1/projects/:id/feature-flags/flags/:flagIdOrSlug?withMetadata=true` for single-flag lookups that need creator metadata.

parameters.description: Maximum number of flags to return. When not set, all flags are returned.

parameters.name: tags
parameters.description: Filter flags by tag. Repeat the parameter for multiple tags (all must match).

parameters.name: teamId
parameters.description: The Team identifier to perform the request on behalf of.

parameters.name: slug
parameters.description: The Team slug to perform the request on behalf of.

put.description: Create a new feature flag for a project. The flag must have a unique slug within the project and specify its kind (boolean, string, number, or json).

parameters.name: projectIdOrName
parameters.description: The project id or name

parameters.name: teamId
parameters.description: The Team identifier to perform the request on behalf of.

parameters.name: slug
parameters.description: The Team slug to perform the request on behalf of.

slug.description: A unique (per project) key for the flag, composed of letters, numbers, dashes, and underscores

environments.description: The configuration for the flag in different environments

reuse.description: Allows linking this environment to another environment so this flag will be evaluated with the other flag's configuration

targets.description: Allows assigning targets to variants while bypassing the flag's rules

revision.description: The revision of the environment config

seed.description: A random seed to prevent split points in different flags from having the same targets

maintainerIds.description: The user ids of the maintainers of the flag

permanent.description: Whether this flag is marked as permanent, indicating it should not be removed

schema.description: Representation of a Flags SDK key returned by CREATE. Includes cleartext secrets (`keyValue`, `tokenValue`, `connectionString`) which are only ever disclosed once, on creation.

partialKeyValue.description: Partially-masked representation of the SDK key value, safe to display in UIs. The value is the `vf_<type>_` prefix followed by the first 3 characters of the secret portion and a fixed 8-character `*` mask (e.g. `vf_server_abc********`).

keyValue.description: Cleartext value of the SDK key.

tokenValue.description: Cleartext value of the Edge Config token, when the project has an Edge Config connection.
